items.caption: This tile shows ONE thermostat large and operable. For an overview of all devices there is the "Comet WiFi Tile" — both can be used side by side.
The dial is the control surface: a tap on it sets the setpoint, the buttons below adjust it in half-degree steps.

Control goes through the device instance, not around it. This means the switch to manual mode configured there also applies from here — without it, the weekly schedule in the device overwrites the setpoint at the next switching point.
"Off" and "On" are the valve's end stops (fully closed or fully open) and are named rather than shown as a temperature.
The tile's title is the name of this instance — so name it after the room. The tile itself does not show a second name, that would be the same information twice.

The weekly schedule runs in the thermostat. If its clock is wrong, every switching point is shifted by the same amount. 0 switches the warning off.

Expanding a tile (double arrow) shows the instance's children, not the tile itself. That is why the module creates links to the thermostat's variables — including the action selection (refresh, fetch schedule, set clock, all fields).

After a module update, Symcon does not always apply an instance's settings by itself. The only other way is to change something in the form and change it back — only then does "Apply" become clickable at all. This button saves you that.
⚠️  Acts on the saved settings. Anything you changed above but have not applied yet is lost.
This is harmless for the devices: applying sends nothing and therefore does not wake any battery.
